verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לְדָוִ֗ד מִזְמ֥וֹר שִֽׁיר׃ יָק֣וּם אֱ֭לֹהִים יָפ֣וּצוּ אוֹיְבָ֑יו וְיָנ֥וּסוּ מְ֝שַׂנְאָ֗יו מִפָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ lə·ḏā·wiḏ miz·mō·wr šîr yā·qūm ’ĕ·lō·hîm yā·p̄ū·ṣū ’ō·wy·ḇāw wə·yā·nū·sū mə·śan·’āw mip·pā·nāw
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David A song God arises His enemies are scattered and those who hate Him flee His presence

verses.original: כְּהִנְדֹּ֥ף עָשָׁ֗ן תִּ֫נְדֹּ֥ף כְּהִמֵּ֣ס דּ֭וֹנַג מִפְּנֵי־ אֵ֑שׁ יֹאבְד֥וּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kə·hin·dōp̄ ‘ā·šān tin·dōp̄ kə·him·mês dō·w·naḡ mip·pə·nê- ’êš yō·ḇə·ḏū rə·šā·‘îm mip·pə·nê ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: As smoke is blown away You will drive them out as wax melts before the fire the wicked will perish in the presence of God

verses.original: וְֽצַדִּיקִ֗ים יִשְׂמְח֣וּ יַֽ֭עַלְצוּ לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֗ים וְיָשִׂ֥ישׂוּ בְשִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣad·dî·qîm yiś·mə·ḥū ya·‘al·ṣū lip̄·nê ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·yā·śî·śū ḇə·śim·ḥāh
verses.literal: But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God they will celebrate with joy

verses.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ׀ לֵֽאלֹהִים֮ זַמְּר֪וּ שְׁ֫מ֥וֹ סֹ֡לּוּ לָרֹכֵ֣ב בָּ֭עֲרָבוֹת בְּיָ֥הּ שְׁמ֗וֹ וְעִלְז֥וּ לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: šî·rū lê·lō·hîm zam·mə·rū šə·mōw sōl·lū lā·rō·ḵêḇ bā·‘ă·rā·ḇō·wṯ bə·yāh šə·mōw wə·‘il·zū lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: Sing to God Sing praises to His name Exalt Him who rides on the clouds His name is the LORD and rejoice before Him

verses.original: אֲבִ֣י יְ֭תוֹמִים וְדַיַּ֣ן אַלְמָנ֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בִּמְע֥וֹן קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇî yə·ṯō·w·mîm wə·ḏay·yan ’al·mā·nō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm bim·‘ō·wn qā·ḏə·šōw
verses.literal: A father of the fatherless and a defender of widows is God in His holy habitation

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ מ֘וֹשִׁ֤יב יְחִידִ֨ים׀ בַּ֗יְתָה מוֹצִ֣יא אֲ֭סִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁר֑וֹת אַ֥ךְ ס֝וֹרֲרִ֗ים שָׁכְנ֥וּ צְחִיחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm mō·wō·šîḇ yə·ḥî·ḏîm bay·ṯāh mō·w·ṣî ’ă·sî·rîm bak·kō·wō·šā·rō·wṯ ’aḵ sō·w·ră·rîm šā·ḵə·nū ṣə·ḥî·ḥāh
verses.literal: God settles the lonely in families He leads the prisoners out to prosperity but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land

verses.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים בְּ֭צֵאתְךָ לִפְנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּצַעְדְּךָ֖ בִֽישִׁימ֣וֹן סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕlō·hîm bə·ṣê·ṯə·ḵā lip̄·nê ‘am·me·ḵā bə·ṣa‘·də·ḵā ḇî·šî·mō·wn se·lāh
verses.literal: O God when You went out before Your people when You marched through the wasteland Selah

verses.original: אֶ֤רֶץ רָעָ֨שָׁה׀ אַף־ שָׁמַ֣יִם נָטְפוּ֮ מִפְּנֵ֪י אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים זֶ֥ה סִינַ֑י מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·reṣ rā·‘ā·šāh ’ap̄- šā·ma·yim nā·ṭə·p̄ū mip·pə·nê ’ĕ·lō·hîm zeh sî·nay mip·pə·nê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain before God the One on Sinai before God the God of Israel

verses.original: גֶּ֣שֶׁם נְ֭דָבוֹת תָּנִ֣יף אֱלֹהִ֑ים נַחֲלָתְךָ֥ וְ֝נִלְאָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה כֽוֹנַנְתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ge·šem nə·ḏā·ḇō·wṯ tā·nîp̄ ’ĕ·lō·hîm na·ḥă·lā·ṯə·ḵā wə·nil·’āh ’at·tāh ḵō·w·nan·tāh
verses.literal: You sent abundant rain O God You refreshed Your weary inheritance

verses.original: חַיָּתְךָ֥ יָֽשְׁבוּ־ בָ֑הּ תָּ֤כִ֥ין בְּטוֹבָתְךָ֖ לֶעָנִ֣י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ḥay·yā·ṯə·ḵā yā·šə·ḇū- ḇāh tā·ḵîn bə·ṭō·w·ḇā·ṯə·ḵā le·‘ā·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Your flock settled therein O God from Your bounty You provided for the poor

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֥י יִתֶּן־ אֹ֑מֶר הַֽ֝מְבַשְּׂר֗וֹת צָבָ֥א רָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy yit·ten- ’ō·mer ham·ḇaś·śə·rō·wṯ ṣā·ḇā rāḇ
verses.literal: The Lord gives the command a great company of women proclaim it

verses.original: מַלְכֵ֣י צְ֭בָאוֹת יִדֹּד֣וּן יִדֹּד֑וּן וּנְוַת בַּ֝֗יִת תְּחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mal·ḵê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yid·dō·ḏūn yid·dō·ḏūn ū·nə·waṯ ba·yiṯ tə·ḥal·lêq šā·lāl
verses.literal: Kings and their armies flee in haste . . . she who waits at home divides the plunder

verses.original: אִֽם־ תִּשְׁכְּבוּן֮ בֵּ֪ין שְׁפַ֫תָּ֥יִם כַּנְפֵ֣י י֭וֹנָה נֶחְפָּ֣ה בַכֶּ֑סֶף וְ֝אֶבְרוֹתֶ֗יהָ בִּֽירַקְרַ֥ק חָרֽוּץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tiš·kə·ḇūn bên šə·p̄at·tā·yim kan·p̄ê yō·w·nāh neḥ·pāh ḇak·ke·sep̄ wə·’eḇ·rō·w·ṯe·hā bî·raq·raq ḥā·rūṣ
verses.literal: Though you lie down among the sheepfolds the wings of the dove are covered with silver and her feathers with shimmering gold

verses.original: בְּפָ֘רֵ֤שׂ שַׁדַּ֓י מְלָ֘כִ֤ים בָּ֗הּ תַּשְׁלֵ֥ג בְּצַלְמֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·p̄ā·rêś šad·day mə·lā·ḵîm bāh taš·lêḡ bə·ṣal·mō·wn
verses.literal: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land it was like the snow falling on Zalmon

verses.original: הַר־ אֱ֭לֹהִים הַר־ בָּשָׁ֑ן הַ֥ר גַּ֝בְנֻנִּ֗ים הַר־ בָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: har- ’ĕ·lō·hîm har- bā·šān har gaḇ·nun·nîm har- bā·šān
verses.literal: A mountain of God is Mount Bashan a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה׀ תְּֽרַצְּדוּן֮ הָרִ֪ים גַּבְנֻ֫נִּ֥ים הָהָ֗ר חָמַ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְשִׁבְתּ֑וֹ אַף־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָנֶֽצַח׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh tə·raṣ·ṣə·ḏūn hā·rîm gaḇ·nun·nîm hā·hār ḥā·maḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·šiḇ·tōw ’ap̄- Yah·weh yiš·kōn lā·ne·ṣaḥ
verses.literal: Why do you gaze in envy O mountains of many peaks This is the mountain God chose for His dwelling where the LORD will surely dwell forever

verses.original: רֶ֤כֶב אֱלֹהִ֗ים רִבֹּתַ֣יִם אַלְפֵ֣י שִׁנְאָ֑ן אֲדֹנָ֥י בָ֝֗ם סִינַ֥י בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: re·ḵeḇ ’ĕ·lō·hîm rib·bō·ṯa·yim ’al·p̄ê šin·’ān ’ă·ḏō·nāy ḇām sî·nay baq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: The chariots of God are tens of thousands thousands of thousands are they the Lord is in His sanctuary as He was at Sinai

verses.original: עָ֘לִ֤יתָ לַמָּר֨וֹם׀ שָׁ֘בִ֤יתָ שֶּׁ֗בִי לָקַ֣חְתָּ מַ֭תָּנוֹת בָּאָדָ֑ם וְאַ֥ף ס֝וֹרְרִ֗ים לִשְׁכֹּ֤ן׀ יָ֬הּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·lî·ṯā lam·mā·rō·wm šā·ḇî·ṯā še·ḇî lā·qaḥ·tā mat·tā·nō·wṯ bā·’ā·ḏām wə·’ap̄ sō·wr·rîm liš·kōn yāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: You have ascended on high You have led captives away . . . You have received gifts from men even from the rebellious that the LORD God may dwell there

verses.original: בָּ֤ר֣וּךְ אֲדֹנָי֮ י֤וֹם׀ י֥וֹם יַֽעֲמָס־ לָ֗נוּ הָ֘אֵ֤ל יְֽשׁוּעָתֵ֬נוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ ’ă·ḏō·nāy yō·wm yō·wm ya·‘ă·mās- lā·nū hā·’êl yə·šū·‘ā·ṯê·nū se·lāh
verses.literal: Blessed be the Lord who daily . . . bears our burden the God of our salvation Selah

verses.original: הָ֤אֵ֣ל׀ לָנוּ֮ אֵ֤ל לְֽמוֹשָׁ֫ע֥וֹת וְלֵיהוִ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֑י לַ֝מָּ֗וֶת תּוֹצָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’êl lā·nū ’êl lə·mō·wō·šā·‘ō·wṯ Yah·weh ’ă·ḏō·nāy lam·mā·weṯ tō·w·ṣā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Our God . . . is a God of deliverance the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death

verses.original: אַךְ־ אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִמְחַץ֮ רֹ֤אשׁ אֹ֫יְבָ֥יו קָדְקֹ֥ד שֵׂעָ֑ר מִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בַּאֲשָׁמָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- ’ĕ·lō·hîm yim·ḥaṣ rōš ’ō·yə·ḇāw qā·ḏə·qōḏ śê·‘ār miṯ·hal·lêḵ ba·’ă·šā·māw
verses.literal: Surely God will crush the heads of His enemies the hairy crowns of those who persist in guilty ways

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי מִבָּשָׁ֣ן אָשִׁ֑יב אָ֝שִׁ֗יב מִֽמְּצֻל֥וֹת יָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy mib·bā·šān ’ā·šîḇ ’ā·šîḇ mim·mə·ṣu·lō·wṯ yām
verses.literal: The Lord said I will retrieve them from Bashan I will bring them up from the depths of the sea

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן׀ תִּֽמְחַ֥ץ רַגְלְךָ֗ בְּ֫דָ֥ם לְשׁ֥וֹן כְּלָבֶ֑יךָ מֵאֹיְבִ֥ים מִנֵּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an tim·ḥaṣ raḡ·lə·ḵā bə·ḏām lə·šō·wn kə·lā·ḇe·ḵā mê·’ō·yə·ḇîm min·nê·hū
verses.literal: that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your foes the tongues of your dogs in the same

verses.original: רָא֣וּ הֲלִיכוֹתֶ֣יךָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים הֲלִ֘יכ֤וֹת אֵלִ֖י מַלְכִּ֣י בַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’ū hă·lî·ḵō·w·ṯe·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm hă·lî·ḵō·wṯ ’ê·lî mal·kî ḇaq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: They have seen Your procession O God the march of my God and King into the sanctuary

verses.original: קִדְּמ֣וּ שָׁ֭רִים אַחַ֣ר נֹגְנִ֑ים בְּת֥וֹךְ עֲ֝לָמ֗וֹת תּוֹפֵפֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: qid·də·mū šā·rîm ’a·ḥar nō·ḡə·nîm bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘ă·lā·mō·wṯ tō·w·p̄ê·p̄ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The singers lead the way the musicians follow after among the maidens playing tambourines

verses.original: בְּֽ֭מַקְהֵלוֹת בָּרְכ֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִמְּק֥וֹר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bə·maq·hê·lō·wṯ bā·rə·ḵū ’ĕ·lō·hîm Yah·weh mim·mə·qō·wr yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Bless God in the great congregation bless the LORD from the fountain of Israel

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם בִּנְיָמִ֨ן׀ צָעִ֡יר רֹדֵ֗ם שָׂרֵ֣י יְ֭הוּדָה רִגְמָתָ֑ם שָׂרֵ֥י זְ֝בֻל֗וּן שָׂרֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šām bin·yā·min ṣā·‘îr rō·ḏêm śā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh riḡ·mā·ṯām śā·rê zə·ḇu·lūn śā·rê nap̄·tā·lî
verses.literal: There is Benjamin the youngest ruling them the princes of Judah in their company the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali

verses.original: צִוָּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ עֻ֫זֶּ֥ךָ עוּזָּ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים ז֝֗וּ פָּעַ֥לְתָּ לָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣiw·wāh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ‘uz·ze·ḵā ‘ūz·zāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm zū pā·‘al·tā lā·nū
verses.literal: Summon Your power O God show Your strength O God which You have exerted on our behalf

verses.original: מֵֽ֭הֵיכָלֶךָ עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְךָ֤ יוֹבִ֖ילוּ מְלָכִ֣ים שָֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: mê·hê·ḵā·le·ḵā ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim lə·ḵā yō·w·ḇî·lū mə·lā·ḵîm šāy
verses.literal: Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts

verses.original: גְּעַ֨ר חַיַּ֪ת קָנֶ֡ה עֲדַ֤ת אַבִּירִ֨ים׀ בְּעֶגְלֵ֬י עַמִּ֗ים מִתְרַפֵּ֥ס בְּרַצֵּי־ כָ֑סֶף בִּזַּ֥ר עַ֝מִּ֗ים קְרָב֥וֹת יֶחְפָּֽצוּ׃
verses.transliteration: gə·‘ar ḥay·yaṯ qā·neh ‘ă·ḏaṯ ’ab·bî·rîm bə·‘eḡ·lê ‘am·mîm miṯ·rap·pês bə·raṣ·ṣê- ḵā·sep̄ biz·zar ‘am·mîm qə·rā·ḇō·wṯ yeḥ·pā·ṣū
verses.literal: Rebuke the beast in the reeds the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations until it submits bringing bars of silver Scatter the nations who delight in war

verses.original: יֶאֱתָ֣יוּ חַ֭שְׁמַנִּים מִנִּ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם כּ֥וּשׁ תָּרִ֥יץ יָ֝דָ֗יו לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ye·’ĕ·ṯā·yū ḥaš·man·nîm min·nî miṣ·rā·yim kūš tā·rîṣ yā·ḏāw lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Envoys will arrive from Egypt Cush will stretch out her hands to God

verses.original: מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ֭אָרֶץ שִׁ֣ירוּ לֵאלֹהִ֑ים זַמְּר֖וּ אֲדֹנָ֣י סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ šî·rū lê·lō·hîm zam·mə·rū ’ă·ḏō·nāy se·lāh
verses.literal: Sing to God O kingdoms of the earth sing praises to the Lord Selah

verses.original: לָ֭רֹכֵב בִּשְׁמֵ֣י שְׁמֵי־ קֶ֑דֶם הֵ֥ן יִתֵּ֥ן בְּ֝קוֹלוֹ ק֣וֹל עֹֽז׃
verses.transliteration: lā·rō·ḵêḇ biš·mê šə·mê- qe·ḏem hên yit·tên bə·qō·w·lōw qō·wl ‘ōz
verses.literal: to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old behold His mighty voice . . . resounds

verses.original: תְּנ֥וּ עֹ֗ז לֵֽאלֹ֫הִ֥ים עַֽל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל גַּאֲוָת֑וֹ וְ֝עֻזּ֗וֹ בַּשְּׁחָקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: tə·nū ‘ōz lê·lō·hîm ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl ga·’ă·wā·ṯōw wə·‘uz·zōw baš·šə·ḥā·qîm
verses.literal: Ascribe the power to God whose majesty is over Israel whose strength is in the skies

verses.original: נ֤וֹרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֗ים מִֽמִּקְדָּ֫שֶׁ֥יךָ אֵ֤ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל ה֤וּא נֹתֵ֨ן׀ עֹ֖ז וְתַעֲצֻמ֥וֹת לָעָ֗ם בָּר֥וּךְ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: nō·w·rā ’ĕ·lō·hîm mim·miq·dā·še·ḵā ’êl yiś·rā·’êl hū nō·ṯên ‘ōz wə·ṯa·‘ă·ṣu·mō·wṯ lā·‘ām bā·rūḵ ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: O God You are awesome in Your sanctuary the God of Israel Himself gives strength and power to His people Blessed be God
